about_the_game:
The WWE 2K25 Deadman Edition Bonus Pack includes:

•MyFACTION Persona Card: Undertaker ‘90

•MyFACTION Persona Card: Mattel Elite Collection Greatest Hits Undertaker

•Usable Urn*

•Brother Love Manager

This content is included in the WWE 2K25 Deadman and The Bloodline Editions.

*Exact release date of Usable Urn to be announced post-launch and subject to change.
